data.short_description: Liquor Junction, a new liquor store, is setting up shop at 2133 Whitten Road in Memphis. It was issued a certificate of occupancy on August 31 and has a sign permit under review as of September 3. The concept does not yet have a digital footprint.

STRONG Pilates is bringing its high-intensity Pilates-inspired workout to Boston's Back Bay. The studio combines Rowformer and Bikeformer machines for strength and cardio training. It is one of three Massachusetts debut locations.

STRONG Pilates is opening a Fenway location as part of its Massachusetts expansion. The studio offers 45-minute workouts combining Pilates, strength, and cardio. It is one of three Greater Boston studios launching this fall.

data.status: opening date will be announced at a later date
data.short_description: STRONG Pilates will open a Kendall Square, Cambridge location as part of its Massachusetts debut. Unlike the Back Bay and Fenway locations, this studio does not yet have a confirmed opening date. It is part of a three-studio Greater Boston expansion.

KidsUnited, a youth soccer development program for children 18 months to 9 years old, is eyeing an expansion into San Antonio's Stone Oak area. Franchise owners Frank and Brianna Cristofol have secured rights to the location. This will add to the brand's growing presence in Texas.

The Cristofols are preparing to open their first KidsUnited location in Georgetown at The Junction Corporate Park. It is expected to open in November, pending permits. This is the franchisees' first location ahead of their planned San Antonio expansion.

btone FITNESS is preparing to open a new studio in Brighton, Boston, brought by franchisee Kelsey Irish. The brand's signature 45-minute workout blends Pilates-inspired movements with strength training and functional movement. btone has grown to more than 40 locations across 10 states.

data.status: An official opening date for the Mandarin store has not been announced
data.short_description: Five Below is expanding its Jacksonville presence with a new store planned for Mandarin, renovating the former Party City space. The store will offer the retailer's familiar mix of affordable toys, tech accessories, room décor and more. It is part of the company's continued nationwide expansion.

data.status: Construction is underway, but an official opening date has not been [specified in available text]
data.short_description: Whole Foods Market is coming to Durbin Park, anchoring The Berkeley, a 106,054-square-foot open-air retail development. The center is being developed by Regency Centers as part of a $55 million project. Construction is underway near the intersection of I-95 and State Road 9B.

EōS Fitness will open a Winter Park location in 2027, replacing an existing LA Fitness at 1540 FL-436. This is one of three additional Central Florida locations beyond the previously reported Colonial Plaza site. The chain is undergoing a major Florida growth push.

data.location: 1700 W New Haven Ave, Melbourne, FL
data.short_description: EōS Fitness is planning a location at Melbourne Square shopping center, opening in 2027. This is part of the chain's broader Central Florida expansion push. The brand offers group fitness classes and personal training.

EōS Fitness will open a third new Central Florida location at 1501 Outlet Blvd in Daytona Beach, planned for 2028. This follows the Winter Park and Melbourne announcements. The chain is focusing growth on Tampa Bay, South Florida, Cape Coral, and Gainesville as well.

Studio Pulse, a rhythm-driven, beat-based fitness studio co-founded by sisters Ashton and Adele Verrengia, plans to debut in South Austin per public filings. The Austin location will be close to the sisters' other concept, Method Pilates. Their first Studio Pulse opened in Houston in January 2026.
